# CANDIDATE: ADJUST_VIX_CONFIRMATION_FOR_BEAR

**Filed:** 2026-08-20
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** filter_change
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Lowering the VIX confirmation threshold for bearish entries from 20 to 18 will increase the number of qualifying trades without significantly degrading edge, as the VIX regime of 18-20 has shown bearish edge in prior analysis.

## Mechanism

Change the VIX confirmation filter in the BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setup from requiring VIX >= 20 to VIX >= 18. All other conditions remain the same. Entry, exit, and position sizing unchanged.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+; $1K paper ~= 14% headline
2. **Sample bias:** Stage-1 backtest would use 16 months of data (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18) with walk-forward splitting. Risk of overfit from parameter tuning; mitigated by holding out OOS window.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (to be run after Stage-1)
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (to be run after Stage-1)
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day: if the filter admits too many low-quality bear trades during low-VIX regimes, could increase losses on choppy days. Max drawdown: unknown without backtest. Blow-up scenario: prolonged low-VIX bear market where the filter admits trades that lose due to lack of follow-through.
6. **Concentration:** unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest to compute top-5 days contribution.

## Pre-merge gate

Gym validators: all tests in `backtest/tests/` must pass; walk-forward: OOS Sharpe ratio >= 0.70 and per-month rate consistency >= 0.70; real-fills: top 3 J day P&L must match BS-sim within ±20%; OP-16 anchor: edge_capture >= 771.
